name: ClientTuning
doc: Client settings for the Tuning Lab. null = keep the service default.

fields.name: acks
fields.doc: "all", "leader" or "none". Anything but "all" disables idempotence (lossy).

fields.name: compression
fields.doc: "none", "gzip", "snappy", "lz4", "zstd".

name: Knobs
doc: Runtime knobs. Every field has a neutral default; services ignore knobs that do not apply to them.

fields.name: paused
fields.doc: Stop consuming without crashing ("Silent Failure", "Recovery Storm").

fields.name: processingLatencyMs
fields.doc: Extra processing time per record and its random jitter.

fields.name: processingErrorProbability
fields.doc: Probability of a transient processing error (retried, never dead-lettered).

fields.name: businessFailureProbability
fields.doc: Probability of a business failure (payment declined, ...). null = service default.

fields.name: providerDown
fields.doc: Payment provider outage: every authorisation fails with PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.

fields.name: dbLatencyMs
fields.doc: Extra latency for each database transaction ("Database Slowdown").

fields.name: netLatencyMs
fields.doc: Client-side network faults on the business Kafka client ("Network Chaos").

fields.name: warehouseOutage
fields.doc: Shipping: warehouse outage, shipments are delayed until it ends.

fields.name: ordersPerSecond
fields.doc: Generator only. null = default rate.

fields.name: popularSku
fields.doc: Generator: share of orders for one popular SKU ("Flash Sale").

fields.name: hotPartition
fields.doc: Generator: share of orders whose id hashes onto one partition ("Hot Partition").

fields.name: paddingBytes
fields.doc: Generator: payload filler per order ("Fat Messages").

fields.name: duplicateProbability
fields.doc: Generator: probability to publish an order twice ("Duplicate Delivery").

fields.name: poisonProbability
fields.doc: Generator: probability to publish an undecodable record ("Poison Message").

fields.name: service
fields.doc: Target service, e.g. "payment". Also the record key.

fields.name: generation
fields.doc: Monotonic per service. Services report the applied generation as a metric.

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.doc: After this instant the service falls back to baseline knobs on its own. null = no expiry.

fields.name: experiments
fields.doc: Active experiment ids (opaque during an Incident Drill).

fields.name: actor
fields.doc: "user", "scheduler", "drill", "system".

fields.name: action
fields.doc: e.g. "experiment.started", "experiment.reverted", "chaos.armed", "panic".

fields.name: scenario
fields.doc: Scenario id, or "hidden" while an Incident Drill is unsolved.
